alt: AI-generated Bosnia and Herzegovina-inspired fashion scene with four fictional adult women in a river-window lounge. A braided woman in a blue, yellow and white star-patterned mini reclines against a blonde companion in pale gold and blue. A woman in pearl and teal crouches beside them, while a fourth in deep teal sits on a higher padded seat. Rainbow ankle boots, teal knee-high boots and varied heels complete the styling. A stone-arch bridge and turquoise river outside form an imagined backdrop.
